root_cause.text: The driver directly uses a device-supplied 32-bit status value as an index into a fixed-size string array (`efr_status_names`) without validating that the index is within bounds, leading to an out-of-bounds read when the status is outside the expected range (e.g., `EFR_STATUS_INCOMPLETE` with value 0x80000000).
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a bounds check (`st < ARRAY_SIZE(efr_status_names)`) before indexing the array and falls back to printing "unknown" otherwise. The commit message explicitly states that the status field is a 32-bit value supplied by the device, the array has only 17 entries, and an out-of-range value (like 0x80000000) leads to out-of-bounds access.
